## What is Lab Automation?


[Lab automation](https://www.scispot.com/jazz) refers to the use of technology to perform laboratory tasks traditionally carried out by human hands. This can include anything from simple liquid handling to complex data analysis and experimental workflows. The goal is to streamline processes, reduce human error, and increase throughput. **Scispot** excels in offering a highly integrated, user-friendly LIMS that adapts to the specific needs of any lab, ensuring smooth and efficient operations.


## Why Is Lab Automation Important?


The importance of[lab automation](https://www.scispot.com/jazz) lies in its ability to optimize and improve overall efficiency. With automation, laboratories can handle a larger volume of work in less time, which is crucial in fields like drug development where time and accuracy are of the essence. By minimizing human intervention, labs can also reduce the risk of errors, leading to more reliable and reproducible results. Unlike many outdated LIMS solutions, **Scispot's** platform offers real-time updates, AI-driven insights, and[seamless integrations](https://www.scispot.com/glue) to keep labs running at their peak.
